title: Climbing & Bouldering Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kaya:session
| eval day_type=if(in(strftime(_time,"%u"),"6","7"),"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(duration_min) as avg_duration by day_type
description: Separates climbing activity between weekdays and weekends when duration is present.
value: Weekend/weekday splits quickly show whether a life domain is work-driven, leisure-driven, or bleeding into the wrong days.
implementation: Populate optional `duration_min` on `kaya:session` events if available; the search still works on counts alone when duration is missing.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart of weekday vs weekend event counts.
grandmaExplanation: It works out whether your climbing activity mostly happens on weekdays or weekends so you can see if the habit fits the life you actually live.
